economy.summary: Her campaign platform supports increasing the minimum wage, saying workers should not struggle to meet basic needs, and backs pay equity for men and women and tax incentives for small businesses that hire workers.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage, pay equity, small-business hiring incentives.

taxes.summary: Her campaign platform says property tax relief should be targeted to primary homesteads, residences, and family farms rather than to large corporations, which she says should pay their full and fair share; she also supports lowering Pennsylvania's corporate net income tax rate.
taxes.short: Targets property tax relief to homesteads; supports lowering corporate rate.

abortion.summary: Voted against Senate Bill 106 in July 2022, a proposed constitutional amendment package that included a provision stating the Pennsylvania Constitution does not grant any right relating to abortion or public funding of abortion.
abortion.short: Voted against 2022 amendment declaring no state constitutional abortion right.

education.summary: Praised the bipartisan 2026-27 state budget's education funding, citing $670 million in new statewide investment including $565 million toward closing historical funding gaps and increases of 1.7% to 10.5% for school districts in the 114th District.
education.short: Praised 2026-27 budget's education funding increases for district schools.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign platform prioritizes affordable health insurance and support for people with pre-existing conditions, drawing on her career as a registered nurse; she introduced House Bill 1888, the Nurse Licensure Compact, on interstate nursing practice standards.
healthcare.short: Prioritizes affordable insurance, pre-existing condition support; nurse licensure bill.

energy.summary: Her campaign platform says Pennsylvania families should have clean air and clean water; she co-sponsored House Bill 1425, a bill to transition Pennsylvania to 100% renewable energy by 2050, and supports a severance tax so natural gas drillers pay their fair share.
energy.short: Co-sponsored 100% renewable transition bill; supports gas severance tax.

guns.summary: Voted for House Bill 714 in May 2023, which would extend criminal background check requirements to private sales of long guns; the bill passed the House 109-92.
guns.short: Voted for expanding background checks to private long-gun sales.
